tagline: National Grid plc owns and operates electricity and gas transmission and distribution networks in the UK and US.
hero_kpi_rationale: Regulated Asset Value (RAV) is the fundamental value driver of a regulated utility (UK + US): the base for authorised revenue and capex.

kpis.name: Regulated Asset Value (RAV)
kpis.explanation: Total regulated asset base (UK + US). Fundamental value driver of a regulated utility.
kpis.signal: Heavy RIIO-T3 and US capex, accelerating growth.

kpis.name: UK Transmission Reliability
kpis.explanation: UK transmission reliability rate, a key Ofgem regulatory metric.

kpis.name: UK Electricity Transmission RAV
kpis.explanation: Regulated asset base of the UK Electricity Transmission segment.
kpis.description: UK Electricity Transmission regulated asset base.

kpis.name: Annual Capital Expenditure
kpis.explanation: Annual capital investment in the regulated networks.

kpis.name: UK Renewable Connections Queue
kpis.explanation: Volume of renewable generation awaiting grid connection in the UK.

kpis.name: Customer Minutes Lost per year
kpis.explanation: Average minutes of supply interruption per customer per year.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Total dividends paid per share over the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total: dividends paid plus buybacks.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of net income redistributed as dividends.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Group revenue over the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share (Diluted)
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the diluted average share count.
